metadata.summary: The customer called to order a hot latte, but the agent was unable to complete the order due to technical issues with the search_for_item tool.

messages.text: Hello Gaurav, Welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It is great to see you again. How can I help you today?
Hello, I'm Emily, nice to talk to you. What can I get for you today at Manhattan Bagel?
I said, can you hear me?
I'd be happy to help you. How can I assist you today at Manhattan Bagel? Would you like to place an order or do you have any questions about our menu?
I want to order hot latte.
I'm going to check on that for you. Let me see what we have.
I apologize, but it seems like the tool timed out. Let me try searching for hot beverages instead.
I apologize, but the tool seems to be experiencing some issues. Let me try searching for drinks to see if I can find any options for you.
I apologize, but I'm still having trouble with the tool. Let me try one more time to find some drink options for you.
